chunks.title: AIB (Allied Irish Banks) (AIB) COP31 Role & Commitments
chunks.text: AIB (Allied Irish Banks) is a Global Commercial Bank headquartered in Ireland. At UNFCCC COP31 in Antalya (November 9-20, 2026), its verified role is: COP31 Business Forum Climate Finance & Investments Working Group member. Verified COP31 2026 climate finance commitment: €30B Climate Action Fund supporting European renewables, green buildings & transition finance. Source verification: https://www.copbusiness.org/papers/COP31_WG_climate-finance-investments.pdf.

chunks.title: AIB Financing Instruments & Ticket Bounds
chunks.text: AIB (Allied Irish Banks) provides the following climate financing instruments: Green Loan, Renewable Project Finance, Green Bond. Typical transaction ticket range is USD 5,000,000 to USD 150,000,000. Eligible applicant profiles include: Large Corporate, Project SPV, SME.

chunks.title: AIB Priority Climate Sectors & Regional Mandate
chunks.text: Priority climate sectors funded by AIB (Allied Irish Banks): Renewable Energy, Green Buildings, Energy Efficiency, Clean Transport. Target geographic focus includes: Europe, EU, United Kingdom. Projects outside primary regions or ticket bounds may require syndicated or on-lending structures.

chunks.title: AIB Mandatory Form & Underwriting Requirements
chunks.text: Mandatory requirements to complete AIB's application form: EU / Ireland / UK project nexus; EU Taxonomy & AIB Green Bond Framework alignment; Credit underwriting & EIA compliance. Explicit exclusion rules: Fossil-fuel generation. Official application portal: https://aib.ie/sustainability.

chunks.title: AIB Form Template: Global Corporate & Investment Bank Green / Sustainability-Linked Finance Mandate Intake
chunks.text: AIB (Allied Irish Banks) uses the 'Global Corporate & Investment Bank Green / Sustainability-Linked Finance Mandate Intake' workflow governed by LMA/APLMA Green Loan Principles (GLP), Sustainability-Linked Loan Principles (SLLP) & ICMA GBP. Typical review timeline is 3–8 weeks (Sustainable Finance Structuring -> Credit Committee -> Syndication/Close). Form sections required: 1. Borrower Overview, 2. Structuring, 3. Transition Credibility, 4. Risk & Underwriting, 5. Mandate Pitch.

chunks.title: AIB Guidance for 'Corporate Borrower & Operating Jurisdiction'

Align response with AIB's COP31 priorities (COP31 Business Forum Climate Finance & Investments Working Group member) and instruments (Green Loan, Renewable Project Finance, Green Bond).
